edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whose allowance is consumed, so the caller controls the authorization branch.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate gates the delegatecall on msg.sender == owner.
init gates the sale parameter assignment on msg.sender == owner.
batchSend gates the distribution on msg.sender == owner and debits msg.sender balance.
setTradeAddress gates the whitelist update on msg.sender == owner.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the supply to the caller.
ERC20.transferFrom spends the allowance of msg.sender acting as spender.
only the owner (msg.sender) can reach the delegatecall sink.
any caller can reach the low-level token call through transferFrom while state mutates afterwards.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for _from and _to.
batchSend reads balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits each recipient.
transferFrom checks and decrements the spender allowance.
ensure whitelists transfers where _from or _to equals owner.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
ensure returns true when canSale[_from] is set.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] with an unchecked ++.
condition enforces _minSale against _value.
condition enforces _maxSale against _value.
condition uses _saleNum to bound per-address sales.
ensure whitelists _from == tradeAddress.
ensure whitelists _from == UNI router constant.
constructor assigns totalSupply from _supply.
transfer forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the pair address.
delegate executes the attacker-supplied delegatecall.
the arbitrary delegatecall can re-enter the contract and rewrite its storage.
callOptionalReturn performs the low-level call.
the low-level token call can re-enter the caller before its bookkeeping completes.
